title: EditorResourcePicker throws "Handle is not initialized" after GC
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 (C#)

### System information

Windows 11 - nvidia rtx 4070 - intel i5 13600 kf (.net 10 + c#14)

### Issue description

EditorResourcePicker can throw "Handle is not initialized" when assigning a C# Resource after previous picker/inspector controls were cleared and garbage collection ran. The issue appears related to C# Resource wrapper lifetime in editor UI controls.

```
ERROR: System.InvalidOperationException: Handle is not initialized.
   at System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle.FromIntPtr(IntPtr value)

       [1] void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113)
       [2] Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.ScriptManagerBridge.SwapGCHandleForType(nint, System.IntPtr*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Bridge/ScriptManagerBridge.cs:1284)

       [4] void Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_1_56(nint, nint, nint) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Generated/NativeCalls.cs:495)
       [5] void Godot.EditorResourcePicker.SetEditedResource(Godot.Resource) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor/Generated/GodotObjects/EditorResourcePicker.cs:153)
       [6] void Godot.EditorResourcePicker.set_EditedResource(Godot.Resource) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharpEditor/Generated/GodotObjects/EditorResourcePicker.cs:41)
       [7] void HandleNotInitRepro.EditorResourcePickerHandleRepro.CreatePickerWithInspector() (E:\Projects\Godot\HandleNotInitRepro\EditorResourcePickerHandleRepro.cs:39)
       [8] void Godot.Callable.<From>g__Trampoline|1_0(object, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Callable.generics.cs:39)
       [9] void Godot.DelegateUtils.InvokeWithVariantArgs(nint, System.Void*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*) (/root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/DelegateUtils.cs:86)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Open the project, press build button. Click on the node in the scene, it has two exported custom buttons at the top in the inspector, press the 1st, then 2nd, then 1st again. (should be triggered, if not repeat.)
